note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records from Mundra Sea (INMUN1) with bill-of-lading numbers, destination countries and HS codes, latest record 2026-02-28. Declared HS 690721 matches the observed export HS 69072100 (glazed vitrified tiles) on 4 of 5 visible rows; one visible row is 69072300 (ceramic glazed wall tiles) — a related tile line, not a contradiction of the declared code. Registered address per customs data: 'SURVEY NO 493 P1 P2, AT JASMATGADH, JETPAR PIPLI ROAD' (Morbi tile cluster, Gujarat). Role: manufacturer-exporter of vitrified/ceramic tiles (own production implied by 'LORENCE VITRIFIED LLP' as shipper of manufactured goods, but production status itself was not independently verified in this pass). Domestic (India) supply side remains unverified — no GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP contract, no annual-report split was retrievable; recorded as unknown, not as 'none found', because the registries were blocked rather than empty. No PAN, CIN or GSTIN is asserted: none was publicly confirmed.
